title: 23.3 EdgeDiff: 418.4mJ/Inference Multi-Modal Few-Step Diffusion Model Accelerator with Mixed-Precision and Reordered Group Quantization
problem: Few-step diffusion models (FSDM) for mobile image generation lack redundancy between denoising steps (unlike standard DMs), and introduce computational bottlenecks in multi-modal encoders/decoders that are sensitive to quantization precision.
motivation: Mobile devices demand on-device image generation, but standard diffusion model accelerators cannot exploit inter-timestep redundancy in FSDMs, and multi-modal FSDMs introduce encoder/decoder bottlenecks requiring careful precision management.
method: EdgeDiff exploits mixed-precision quantization and reordered group quantization across encoder, UNet, and decoder components of multi-modal FSDMs, achieving efficient inference without inter-timestep redundancy exploitation.
key_novelty: Mixed-precision and reordered group quantization as unified scheme for multi-modal FSDM accelerator without relying on inter-timestep redundancy.
contributions: Reordered group quantization reducing precision loss
Efficient encoder/decoder processing for multi-modal models
limitations: Abstract-only; image quality metrics (FID, LPIPS), latency breakdown, memory bandwidth requirements, and accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs not discussed.
primary_theme: Mixed-precision few-step diffusion accelerator for edge image generation
